knowledge_graph.title: Flower Mound High School
knowledge_graph.description: Flower Mound High School is part of Lewisville Independent School District and is located in Flower Mound, Texas, United States. The school rests on 52 acres of land that was purchased in 1993. With the expansion of the town in the 1980s and 1990s, FMHS was built to accommodate the growth.
